title: Coral and the Passage
premise: Astrid Ashgrove, a disgraced railroad engineer living off the grid along a river of closed lines, pulls a sealed chest from the floodwater — stamped with the crest of Vellmark, a nation erased from every map twenty years ago. Inside are survey documents proving the mountain pass was deliberately collapsed with workers inside, a crime pinned on Astrid's missing mentor. Hunted by the railway company's private enforcers and shadowed by a Vellmarki exile who wants the chest for her own people's reckoning, Astrid must cross the Corren Range ahead of the snows, reaching the glacier before calving season opens the high route for one brief week. At the pass, Astrid chooses truth over safety, broadcasting the surveys to every station on the line and surrendering to face trial — not as a fugitive, but as the engineer who finally made the mountains testify.
about_author: Felix Zhou is a former track surveyor who spent six years mapping decommissioned rail lines across the northern ranges before turning to fiction. He writes adventure stories about people the maps forgot.

chapters.title: The River Gives Up Its Dead
chapters.summary: Astrid Ashgrove, living invisibly in a squatter's cabin along a closed rail spur, dredges a waterlogged chest from the spring flood. POV: Astrid. Beat: wary curiosity curdling into dread when they recognize the Vellmark seal their mentor once wore.

chapters.title: What the Chest Carries
chapters.summary: Inside: brass instruments, a child's photograph, and survey plates proving the Halden Pass tunnel was blown with two hundred workers inside. POV: Astrid. Beat: grief and guilt — these are papers Astrid was supposed to destroy years ago.

chapters.title: The Debt Collector
chapters.summary: Company man Ivo Renner arrives at the settlement asking after 'the Ashgrove engineer.' Astrid hides the chest in an old culvert. POV: Astrid. Beat: the old fear returns; invisibility is already failing.

chapters.title: A Stranger at the Crossing
chapters.summary: Mira Vell, a Vellmarki exile ferry-woman, recognizes the seal on Astrid's mud-stained coat cuff and follows them home. POV: Mira. Beat: cold calculation — she has hunted this chest her whole life.

chapters.title: Terms
chapters.summary: Mira offers passage and mountain knowledge in exchange for the surveys; Astrid refuses to hand over the dead workers' only testimony. POV: Astrid. Beat: first spark of purpose beyond survival.

chapters.title: Renner's Ledger
chapters.summary: Renner burns the settlement's bridge as pressure, revealing he knows about the chest. POV: Renner. Beat: chilling competence — he sees justice as a line item to be closed.

chapters.title: The Closed Lines Map
chapters.summary: Astrid unrolls their life's work: a hand-drawn map of every abandoned rail line through the Correns, including one route the company believes impassable. POV: Astrid. Beat: the engineer's pride reawakens into resolve.

chapters.title: Uneasy Partnership
chapters.summary: Astrid and Mira strike a fragile bargain: cross together, decide together at the summit. POV: Mira. Beat: grudging respect masked as pragmatism.

chapters.title: The Culvert Ambush
chapters.summary: Renner's men find the culvert; Astrid springs a flood-gate trap learned from river engineering, buying a night's head start. POV: Astrid. Beat: exhilaration shadowed by the knowledge there's no going back.

chapters.title: Up the Dead Spur
chapters.summary: The pair hike a rusted incline railway, sleeping in a rotting brake-house. Mira tells the story of Vellmark's erasure. POV: Mira. Beat: grief shared becomes trust tentatively offered.

chapters.title: The First Snowline
chapters.summary: Early snow dusts the passes; the calving window is shrinking. They find a frozen body clutching a company pay chit. POV: Astrid. Beat: the mountain begins keeping score.

chapters.title: Halden Station Ghosts
chapters.summary: They shelter in the ruined station above the collapsed tunnel; Astrid finds their mentor's initials scratched beside two hundred names. POV: Astrid. Beat: the debt becomes personal, almost devotional.

chapters.title: Renner Ascends
chapters.summary: Renner hires local guides and a telegraph operator, turning the pursuit into a coordinated hunt. POV: Renner. Beat: patience — he intends to take them alive, or what passes for alive.

chapters.title: The Wire
chapters.summary: Astrid taps a live telegraph spur and learns the company is offering a reward using Astrid's real name — someone talked. POV: Astrid. Beat: betrayal's sting, then clarity about who still matters.

chapters.title: Crevasse Country
chapters.summary: Mira leads them onto the glacier's tongue; a hidden crevasse nearly takes Astrid, saved by Mira's rope-work. POV: Mira. Beat: fear transmuted into something like loyalty.

chapters.title: The Calving
chapters.summary: They witness the glacier calve — a cathedral of ice collapsing into the meltwater, opening the high route days early. POV: Astrid. Beat: awe that dwarfs both their causes.

chapters.title: Camp of the Exiles
chapters.summary: A hidden camp of Vellmarki descendants tends a shrine of names; some want the chest destroyed, others broadcast. POV: Mira. Beat: belonging offered — and its price questioned.

chapters.title: Split Counsel
chapters.summary: The exiles vote to keep the surveys secret until Vellmark can be restored; Mira must choose between her people and the truth. POV: Mira. Beat: the theme of justice outside law made flesh.

chapters.title: Stolen Back
chapters.summary: Astrid takes the chest by night rather than let it be buried again — and leaves a map showing where they'll surface. POV: Astrid. Beat: shame braided with certainty.

chapters.title: Mira's Choice
chapters.summary: Mira catches up alone, having defied her elders; she demands to finish the crossing as a partner, not a guard. POV: Mira. Beat: forgiveness asked and granted without ceremony.

chapters.title: The Switchback
chapters.summary: Renner's party gains on them via a working funicular; an avalanche engineered by Astrid buries the track, trapping guides. POV: Astrid. Beat: horror at using the killer's method — the crime repeating in miniature.

chapters.title: Digging Out
chapters.summary: Against Mira's protest, Astrid descends to dig out the buried guides; two survive, one does not. POV: Astrid. Beat: the line they refuse to cross, drawn in snow and blood.

chapters.title: Renner Unmasked
chapters.summary: One freed guide, a former tunnel worker, recognizes Renner as the man who lit the fuse twenty years ago. POV: guide Tomas. Beat: the hunter revealed as the original criminal.

chapters.title: The Bargain at the Shrine
chapters.summary: Renner offers Astrid full pardon and reinstatement for the chest; Astrid counters: confess on the open wire, and the chest goes free. POV: Renner. Beat: contempt cracking into genuine fear.

chapters.title: Whiteout
chapters.summary: A three-day storm pins both parties in adjacent ruins; they share fire across a stone wall, neither trusting the other's word. POV: Mira. Beat: exhausted truce, human and provisional.

chapters.title: The Window Opens
chapters.summary: Clear skies reveal the calved route — a week, no more. Both parties race for the summit wire station. POV: Astrid. Beat: breathless momentum.

chapters.title: The Ice Bridge
chapters.summary: Crossing a melting ice arch, Renner forces a confrontation mid-span; Mira cuts the far anchor, stranding him on the wrong side. POV: Mira. Beat: ruthless mercy — delay, not death.

chapters.title: Summit Station
chapters.summary: They reach the derelict wire station above Halden Pass and find the telegraph line still live from the valley below. POV: Astrid. Beat: trembling readiness — the whole story balanced on a key.

chapters.title: Two Hundred Names
chapters.summary: Astrid keys out the survey data, then reads all two hundred names into the wire while stations down the line repeat them. POV: Astrid. Beat: catharsis — the mountain testifies at last.

chapters.title: Renner Arrives
chapters.summary: Renner breaks in, gun drawn, but valley stations are already relaying his name alongside the victims'; his own men lower his weapon. POV: Renner. Beat: power dissolving as witnesses multiply.

chapters.title: The Descent Begins
chapters.summary: Snows close the pass behind them; Astrid, Mira, and the surviving guides descend the eastern face toward the valley courts. POV: Mira. Beat: quiet resolve replacing flight.

chapters.title: The Inquiry at Brassenford
chapters.summary: A public inquiry convenes; Astrid surrenders the chest and their own confession of the avalanche death. POV: Astrid. Beat: accountability chosen over absolution.

chapters.title: Testimony
chapters.summary: Tomas and the exiles testify; Renner's ledgers unravel the company's cover-up layer by layer. POV: Tomas. Beat: justice arriving slowly, imperfectly, but publicly.

chapters.title: The Verdict
chapters.summary: Renner is convicted; the company settles reparations with Vellmarki families; Astrid receives a suspended sentence for the guide's death. POV: Astrid. Beat: relief laced with the cost made plain.

chapters.title: Restoration Papers
chapters.summary: Vellmark's recognition process begins; the exiles ask Mira to serve as surveyor-general of the old lines. POV: Mira. Beat: belonging achieved on her own terms.

chapters.title: The Offer
chapters.summary: The railway offers Astrid chief engineer of the reopening — building the line through the pass properly this time. POV: Astrid. Beat: temptation of redemption through the very trade that broke them.

chapters.title: Ashgrove's Answer
chapters.summary: Astrid accepts, but only with Mira co-signing every survey and the names carved into the new station wall. POV: Astrid. Beat: identity reclaimed — engineer, survivor, witness.

chapters.title: First Steel
chapters.summary: Spring: the first new rail is laid above Halden Pass; workers observe a minute of silence at the old tunnel mouth. POV: Mira. Beat: mourning folded into forward motion.

chapters.title: The Train Through
chapters.summary: The inaugural train crosses the range carrying two hundred families to see the names; Astrid rides in the cab, compass on the console. POV: Astrid. Beat: arrival — the journey's meaning completed.

chapters.title: Coral and the Passage
chapters.summary: Years later, Astrid teaches surveying to Vellmarki youth, the coral-painted chest displayed in the station museum. POV: Astrid. Beat: peace earned — belonging no longer borrowed, but built.
